newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to sell at least 40 pct of mill.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to sell at least 40 pct of mill.

text.p: The Egyptian state Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said on Monday it was offering at least 40 percent of its Upper Egypt Flour Mills for sale to the private sector.
The sale of 2.80 million shares, at 40 pounds each, will be on September 15 and 16. It is the fifth mill to be partially sold by the government as part of its privatisation programme.
Individuals are offered 20 percent, or 1.40 million shares. This amount can be increased to meet the demand, the company said.
Mutual funds and investment firms can apply for 700,000 shares.
The holding company allocated 10 percent of the total seven million shares for the firms' employees.
The company said shareholders would be eligible for at least 3.85-pound-dividend for the financial year 1995/96, which ended on June 30.
The firm's net profits jumped by about 33.50 percent to 42.533 million pounds in 1995/96 from 31.863 million a year earlier.
Net sales rose by 10.24 percent to 601.739 million pounds last financial year from 545.821 million in 1994/95.
